review_scope: Current helper/trainer diff, CPU target witness and latest FOUR-argument runner, including the added own|c1 prefix factor. Source gate only; no GPU M0 or training-performance acceptance.

source_checks.gt_separation: forward still supplies DECISION_FIELDS only. select_actions is unchanged and reads no GT utility fields. The helper precomputes the utility table, but determines each action from existing scores/decision masks before looking up that action's GT utility. Changing GT does not change the seven selector decisions.
source_checks.same_selector_local_reference: The reference is the same detached selector with all extra regions unavailable through its existing search controller. It includes original-region candidate changes and regular/pause selection. Each forced case exposes only the original region plus one selected extra region, retaining score, verification and .03 intervention rules.
source_checks.gross_gain_and_cost: Selector labels equal chosen gross action utility minus the same-selector local-only gross utility. The label does not subtract .01. Existing controller, action-score and cached evaluation cost handling remain unchanged; the new target does not deduct search cost a second time or reward local-only improvements.
source_checks.success_and_rank_targets: Success is selected current IoU at least .5 for a nonempty extra region. Region ranking consumes the resulting marginal gains with the existing >.05 beneficial-query mask and unchanged rank-loss weight. Success is not an assertion that the extra region supplied the final selected candidate.
source_checks.empty_regions: Empty extra regions receive exactly zero gain and success, as specified.
source_checks.detachment_and_mutation: torch.no_grad covers all target computation. Search-control tensors are replaced in a shallow copied output dictionary; original output tensors are not mutated. Target generation consumes no RNG and creates no target gradient path into the selector.
source_checks.legacy_inference: AST comparison with HEAD confirms InstanceMemory, RecoverabilityModules, select_actions and action_utility are unchanged. There are no parameter/schema, architecture, verification, threshold or inference changes.
source_checks.default_oracle: The default mode remains oracle. Its region gain and success formulas are preserved, and complete old/new objective outputs were checked for bitwise equality using actual cached labels plus bounded supplied output tensors.
source_checks.other_losses: Only search value, search success and search ranking targets can change between modes. The other10 reported loss terms, including candidate absence and A/C supervision, remain identical for the same supplied outputs/data. Shared parameters may still receive different gradients from the changed search loss, as expected.
source_checks.trainer_wiring: Mode and threshold are passed consistently to training, validation, initial metrics and strict checkpoint-reload validation. The fifth positional evaluate argument remains details. Checkpoint selection still uses held validation utility rather than training/validation loss.
source_checks.initialization_and_order: Each M0/full invocation starts a fresh seeded process, constructs the unchanged model from frozen C1, and creates a fresh AdamW. The runner never loads an M0 checkpoint. Same seed and unchanged initialization/shuffle operations preserve the intended matched setup; target computation itself consumes no RNG.
source_checks.four_arm_prefix_extension: Latest fourth argument accepts only own or c1, switches only the final TRAIN prefix root, and preserves prefer-last-prefix and the common128 validation cache. Both output roots and report labels include mode and prefix, with separate m0/full roots.
source_checks.completion_and_weights: The runner rejects an existing output root, requires completed chosen-prefix and validation caches, emits training_completed only after successful training, and uses the retained best.pth for full98 evaluation. With set -euo pipefail, the full job marker follows successful CPU GT report only. Trainer retention remains best.pth only per run.
source_checks.full_video_evaluation: Full stage uses the existing evaluator with fixed seed42, full pretrained inputs and the original98 development split, with no sequence/frame cap. CUDA-hidden reporting compares against full GOLA baseline and C1 using GT; its sequence-mean IoU is internal full-video evidence, not official-test acceptance.

independent_cpu_evidence.execution_method: Extracted actual functions via AST and executed pure CPU tensor/loss arithmetic in memory. No model construction, neural forward, backward pass, optimizer or production deployment.

local_pause_witness.condition: Original keep raw score .9; TIR target probability .4 denies its regular action. Same selector chooses the original pause action both locally and with each extra region.

runtime_gate.scope: Source PASS authorizes the planned four M0 invocations. Under the planned M0-first workflow, all four must actually complete one epoch/four updates with finite losses, changed A/B/C, positive real gradients, frozen C1, strict best reload and acceptable measured capacity before the full experiment stage.
runtime_gate.orchestration: The script is a stage runner; it does not automatically chain or inspect M0 before a full invocation. The parent controls M0-first scheduling and M0-weight cleanup. Full initialization remains independent of M0 weights.
runtime_gate.latest_plan_interpretation: The latest explicit four-arm instruction governs. Older 'both arms' wording in plan.json's m0_gate should be read as all four current mode/prefix combinations.

interpretation_limits: Selector targets adapt to the current model on cached causal states; future utilities still come from frozen-C1 continuations. They are not complete on-policy future outcomes.

The four current B256 arms match one another in seed, query budget, exposure and updates. Compared with prior B128/30-epoch runs, B256/60 epochs retain240 updates but double example exposure; that comparison does not isolate batch size.

Success remains selected localization correctness. The unchanged search controller multiplies predicted value by predicted success; source correctness does not guarantee that this training change improves tracking.
The128 cache and98 videos are reused development validation. Cached loss/utility gains and CPU witnesses cannot substitute for completed continuous full-video comparisons.
No .5-to-argmax gate change is introduced, and no new seed-count acceptance rule is added.
